freePlan.limits: 0 credits/month (pack purchases only), 2 parallel video generations and 2 parallel image+audio generations, all models, no watermark.

keyLimits.en: 0 credits/month (pack purchases only), 2 parallel video generations, 2 parallel image+audio generations, all models, no watermark.
900 credits/month, 2 parallel video generations, 8 parallel image+audio generations.
3,150 credits/month, 8 parallel video generations, 32 parallel image+audio generations, commercial license included.
8,550+ credits/month, unlimited parallel generations, commercial license, priority queue.
Custom credits/month, unlimited parallel generations, dedicated support.

cautions.en: Only the Creator plan and above include a commercial license; Free and Starter outputs cannot be used commercially.
Free plan has no monthly credits at all, only credit-pack top-ups, so it is not usable for any sustained generation.

capabilities.en: AI video generation from text prompts, including multi-shot videos up to 30 seconds, plus video extension and motion transfer.
Image generation and editing (swap, remove, restyle elements), including product shots and reusable custom characters.
Audio tools: music generation (Pika Music), sound effects (Pika SFX), and speech synthesis with multiple voices.
Aggregates multiple third-party AI models (Seedance, MiniMax, GPT Image, Gemini Omni Flash, Grok Imagine) behind one interface, plus a developer API.

limitations.en: Commercial license is gated to the Creator plan and above; lower tiers cannot legally use outputs commercially.
Free plan carries no recurring credits, making it unusable beyond one-off top-up purchases.
Priority queue and early access to new models are reserved for the top Fancy/Enterprise tiers, so lower-tier users face slower generation and delayed access to new models.

reason.en: Direct competitor in AI video generation with a comparable credit-based pricing model.

unknowns: Exact credit cost per second of video or per image generation, needed to translate the monthly credit allowance into a concrete output volume, was not published on the pricing page.
